facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine back to Warwick the smith, in exchange for the loan of his mithril chain shirt; Warwick holds the party's plate armor (claimed by Sir Phidipaldi to be Sir Brandon's original) as collateral.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's heirloom armor, which he lent them for the trip to the Dwarven mine.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt over his leather armor (on loan), greatly improving his protection and halving damage from magic weapons and spells.

The entrance of the Dwarven mine, north of town past King Hogboon's goblin ruins, is sealed by a cave-in, blocking access to the metal Warwick wants. It looks natural and can be dug through; Dunk has begun clearing it, uncovering a dead dwarf.
